This is not a hands-off architecture role, and it is not a routine ticket-handling role. Lead architecture decisions across Azure, VMware, datacenter, remote-site, and edge environments, balancing risk, cost, resilience, operational supportability, and business value. Support cloud governance forums by bringing clear architecture options, decision-ready recommendations, and practical implementation guidance. Hands-on experience or strong leadership experience with Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, automation, Git-based workflows, and infrastructure deployment standards. Experience planning or supporting migrations from on-premises or VMware environments to Azure or other cloud platforms. Ability to guide engineers and offshore teams through implementation without needing to personally click every button. Ability and willingness to provide Level 3 escalation support for complex Azure or VMware platform matters when required. Exposure to modern data, edge, or digital platform enablement patterns from an infrastructure perspective is strongly preferred.
